checks.method: regex over every path in the payload
checks.why: Every path in the whole payload — package directories, modules, bytecode, metadata directories, data files — swept for a forbidden name. Cheap, exhaustive, and it cannot be satisfied by anything except the files actually being gone. Scoped to huggingface_hub's inference tree rather than any directory called `inference`, because model2vec ships a local `model2vec/inference` head-pipeline that runs entirely on this machine and is not a hosted path.

checks.classification: environment-scrub argument in the compiled shell
checks.method: counted occurrences of the declared literal and of every forbidden name in the same file
checks.why: src-tauri/src/main.rs removes ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from the backend child process's environment. The literal is therefore present in the compiled binary as the name of a variable being DELETED, not as an implementation, an import, a registration or a selectable identifier. It is declared here so the inspection reports it explicitly instead of quietly not looking; the count is asserted, so a second, undeclared occurrence still fails.

checks.classification: default value of the per-tenant `aiModel` setting
checks.method: counted occurrences of the declared literal and of every forbidden name in the same file
checks.why: Settings.aiModel is a tenant preference, not a provider: it names no implementation, registers nothing, and selects no provider. The desktop never uses it for generation — app.desktop.apply_model_runtime always exports the configured ModelRuntimeConfig.model (default gemma4:e12b) and app.answer prefers the provider's own model over the setting — and the desktop UI has no control that displays it. The selection probes below assert the reported generation model, so the claim is checked rather than argued.
